subject: Skyloom onboarding: privacy gate, DPA and PO details
messages:
From: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@skyloom.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@skyloom.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup: DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list and PO template

Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking our onboarding call this morning. Procurement needs to complete our vendor gate check so we can issue a PO and get you into our systems. Can you please provide the following by EOD Wednesday so we can keep the timeline for a target go-live on 2026-12-01?

- Signed DPA (or DocuSign link we can sign)
- Link to your most recent SOC 2 report (or read-only copy we can access)
- Current subprocessor list (including region/data center locations)
- A copy of Redwood's vendor remit/billing details (name, tax ID, W9/WOE if US)

I've attached our PO template to make sure the format will work on our side. If any of the items require a security point-of-contact, please indicate who we should loop in.

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Skyloom Systems

Attachments:
- vendor_PO_template.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: DPA, SOC 2 link, subprocessor list and PO template

Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear list. We're happy to move quickly. For the items you requested:

- Attached: Redwood_DPA_Template.pdf and Redwood_Subprocessors_v2.xlsx (contains current subprocessors + regions).
- SOC 2 report: we host a read-only copy; Marissa sent the link last quarter but I'll include an updated link in the next message.
- Billing/remit: Redwood Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789), remit to: Redwood Inference, 1202 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94103. Finance prefers PO followed by email invoice to ap@redwood.ai. Let me know if you need a W9.

Quick ask: does Skyloom require specific subprocessor contractual language, or is the standard Redwood DPA sufficient? If you need custom language we can route to Legal but that may add time.

I cc'd Marissa (security/compliance) and Karthik (procurement ops) so we're all aligned.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the checklist, and Ben thanks for sharing the docs. A few clarifications from the security side:

- SOC 2: latest report (Type II, period ending 2026-05-31) is available here: https://redwood-secure.box.com/s/soc2-report-2026-05-31 (read-only link, requires email address for access). Please confirm which email you'll use and we will grant viewer access.

- Subprocessors file contains columns for name, purpose, country, and data scope. If you need an enterprise-only list (redacted for public-facing subprocessors), let us know and we can produce that variant.

- DPA: the attached Redwood_DPA_Template.pdf includes our standard subprocessor clause. If Skyloom needs an amendment, please highlight the specific sections. We can execute via DocuSign for speed — sample envelope will be generated and shared if you confirm acceptance of the template.

- PO logistics: Finance accepts standard PO to create a vendor record. Karthik — can you share the vendor onboarding form link for Skyloom (tax & remittance fields) so Aisha can fill?

Security contact: marissa_cole@redwood.ai (cc'd). For technical questions about encryption/keys, loop in rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai.

Regards,
